market_summary: Market mood is risk-on and recovering: a Bitcoin crash plus renewed Chinese buying pressure have pushed knives, gloves and case-hardened items sharply higher, while the IEM Cologne Major (Spirit & FUT into Stage 3) is the dominant attention driver. The single biggest volatility catalyst is the souvenir-craft exploit that crashed collectible souvenir prices — avoid souvenir collectibles entirely. Doppler-pattern knives show massive 7-day swings; many sit near 7-day LOWS while the Chinese-driven pump narrative is positive, creating asymmetric buy setups in liquid items. Key risks: knife swing% is inflated by phase/pattern price aggregation and thin volume, so liquidity (vol>20) and tight entries matter most.
